purpose: Product utilization is evaluated in fixed 900-second wall-clock windows, independent of worker boundaries, using substantive durable evidence rather than heartbeat-only writes.

windows.basis: A stricter re-audit excluded ACTIVITY-only heartbeat commits. Coverage amount was sufficient, but one substantive-evidence gap was 125 seconds, exceeding the 120-second acceptance contract by 5 seconds. The earlier PASS is revoked rather than weakening the metric.
Epoch 18 remains active. For this window, keep substantive durable evidence gaps <=120 seconds; ACTIVITY-only refreshes do not count.

acceptance: Three consecutive audited fixed windows with >=840 seconds useful coverage and <=120-second substantive durable-evidence gaps establish the initial P0 utilization pass. Heartbeat-only commits never satisfy the gap contract.
